gating_semantics: Within one execution branch, only a passing gate authorizes the next gate; all STOP outcomes are terminal. All post-freeze behavioral changes require a fresh review.

numerical.reference: B0 native tied-W dense embedding backward on the same fixed R26 CPU start and R27R2 varied bank
numerical.comparison_rule: every tensor element finite and abs(candidate - B0) <= 0.01 + 0.01 * abs(B0), same dtype/shape

priority_hypotheses: baseline B0 repeatability under frozen state/inputs
native dense embedding backward vs sorted-unique inverse-remap compact embedding backward
CCE classifier gradient comparison under matched hidden/lse
optimizer state propagation and step-4 first-moment discrepancy
attribution.failure_samples: deterministic first 32 failing flattened indices and top 32 largest threshold-excess indices, plus actual got/ref/abs/error bound, token ID/row frequency, count and rate
attribution.peak_and_scratch_bounds: Use chunked host comparisons and record memory; no unbounded VxH shadow or permanently retained raw tensor dumps.

correction.effect: A precisely scoped change with mathematically equivalent tied-W gradient/update semantics. It must be separately labeled candidate and remain opt-in to preserve historical R26/R27R2 behavior.
correction.accepted_if: The targeted component discrepancy is eliminated for its stated cause AND all original four-step B1 B0/C1/S2 checks pass with unchanged tolerance/state/inputs.
test_before_full_B1: small synthetic duplicate-token and unique-token semantics including atomics/order as needed
no S2 full dense gradient or hidden shadow
preserve: R26 B0 reference, common W/m/v/RNG and step
same six model payloads, CCE meta, BF16 tied W and FP32 AdamW
full frozen backbone forward and dH backward
S2 4096-row tile geometry and no full VxH gradient/shadow
same loss, attention, input labels and all step states
correction.if_unresolved: STOP; do not run capacity or repeatedly adjust precision, tolerances, tile, input, reference or allocator

capacity.positive_same_B_witness: C1 adjacent 3/3 OOM at C1 largest confirmed PASS+1; S2 same physical B 3/3 PASS

resources.cpu_parallelism: only independent CPU/read-only work after CPU/RAM/I/O/mount checks
resources.fail_closed_shell: set -euo pipefail plus explicit status for each child, never hide failure behind tee

forbidden: download or modify model/tokenizer/corpus/seed or regenerate token bank
different input offset or data-dependent token selection
new bootstrap/reseed optimizer moments/change common state
post-hoc tolerance change or using only mean/cosine for equivalence
B0 baseline weakness or silently changing B0 reference
auto OOM fallback; empty_cache or GC between steps
node174/Accel-Sim, hardware/PPA, second model/corpus or production deployment
promoting discovery input to independent holdout
